title: Unit-preserving scalar-cone comparison with actual finite integral quotients
statement: For the actual completed integral coefficient ring on the small pro-etale site of T and any K-flat complex P, let μ act on every section by the constant uniformizer sent into that completion. Then the strict Roos completion of Cone(μ^(n+1)), with (μ,1) transitions, is isomorphic in the derived category to the strict Roos complex of the actual finite quotient reductions of P. There is such an isomorphism c for which Q(unit_cone) followed by c equals Q(unit_quotient) as whole derived morphisms, including the zero homotopy coordinate. No flatness of individual terms is required.

source.place: Tags 0999, 099B and 0A0E; sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0941 for the normalized strict Roos model

proof.text: Take the strict, levelwise quasi-isomorphic normalized augmented comparison supplied by the principal-cone quotient augmentation. Its adjacent equations imply that its product map commutes with one minus the two shifts.

Exact countable products make the product map a quasi-isomorphism. The induced map between the two cone triangles has invertible first two vertices after localization; therefore its third vertex is invertible. Shift by minus one and localize to obtain the displayed Roos isomorphism.

After every product projection, the equation for the inclusions in the augmented comparison identifies the two product augmentations. Naturality of the zero-homotopy cocone lift gives the equality of the entire strict units. Localization preserves this equality, which proves the required unit equation.

proof_origin.place: Singleton Koszul completion and its strict augmented cone model, specialized without identifying site and coefficient universes.

lean.statement:
theorem integralPrincipalConeQuotientComparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] (T : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{t})
    (P : IntegralOnSlice.Cx l E T none)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := IntegralOnSlice.ring l E T none) P)
    (μ : End P)
    (hμ : ∀ (q : ℤ) (U : T.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : (P.X q).val.obj U),
      (μ.f q).val.app U x =
        (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E T).hom.app U
          ((toSheafify (AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.ProEt.topology T)
            ((Functor.const T.ProEtᵒᵖ).obj
              (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{t + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))))).app U
                (ULift.up (Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E))) • x) :
    ∃ c : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.completion μ) ≅
        DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((IntegralOnSlice.roos l E T none).obj P),
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (CochainComplex.PrincipalCone.unit μ) ≫ c.hom =
        DerivedCategory.Q.map (IntegralOnSlice.roosUnit l E T none P)
